name: s7-bot-scale
goal: @all Construction robots are online. Build like a player with bots now: stamp proven designs as ghosts (designs/stamp), keep the roboport's storage chest stocked with building materials, add roboports to cover where you build, and let the robots place things while you supply and connect them. Target: double the research rate (science consumed per minute) and keep every lab busy.

score.name: science_consumed_per_min
score.note: one-minute flow of packs into labs; target = 2x the rate at the start

score.name: robot_built
score.note: entities placed by construction robots during the run

score.name: techs_researched
score.lua: local k=0 for _,t in pairs(f.technologies) do if t.researched then k=k+1 end end return k

score.name: construction_robots
score.lua: local k=0 for _,n in pairs(f.logistic_networks['nauvis'] or {}) do k=k+n.all_construction_robots end return k
